title: Customizing CoreDNS
description: The Corefile as a configuration file rather than a black box: stub domains, rewrites, a hosts block that silently takes over every name in its server block, why plugin order is not the order you wrote, and the broken Corefile that takes nothing down until a Pod restarts

steps.title: Make the Corefile tell you what it's doing
A zone this cluster doesn't own
A name that isn't a Service
The plugin that answers for names you never gave it
Break it, and notice what doesn't happen
